target.title: Immortal Beloved
target.flavorText: You've loved them before. You'll love them after. The names change. The recognition, when it comes, never does.

target.title: Melodic Note
target.flavorText: One perfect note. Held forever. It does to a room what the right song does to a hard day.

target.title: Photographic Memory
target.flavorText: A gift with no trash folder. You will recall this sentence on your deathbed, unfortunately.

target.title: Sixth Sense
target.flavorText: Comes with no instructions, no off switch, and no warranty. The universe whispers; it declines to clarify.

target.title: Ghost Friend
target.flavorText: Loyal beyond death and twice as stubborn. Excellent company. Terrible at letting things go, which is sort of the whole situation.

target.title: Dreamcatcher Hat
target.flavorText: Catches dreams. Does not sort them. You'll have to check the web yourself, and some of what's stuck there is staring back.

target.title: The Author Likes You
target.flavorText: You are the favorite. It's wonderful until you remember that authors adore putting their favorites through absolute hell.

target.title: Common
target.description: Reliable. Present. Does what it says. Nobody writes songs about it, which is fine — it is busy working.
